title: Authy API support becomes limited to qualifying existing customers
summary: Twilio documentation states that customers using Authy TOTP or Push before March 1, 2023 remain supported, while the Authy API is closed to new customers and planned for future full deprecation.
migration_path: Use Twilio Verify v2 for new development and migrate supported Authy integrations before a future End-of-Life boundary.
user_impact: New customers cannot adopt Authy API, while eligible existing customers remain supported pending an unspecified future End-of-Life date.
notes: The event records the documented support-scope boundary, not a full API shutdown.
